name: Calendar Watchlist
description: Human-curated calendars and recurring feeds Puddles checks for ages 0–5 activities. Distinct from Discovery library scrapers (BiblioCommons / LibCal) and from the live Events catalog.

sources.name: Google Visitor Experience
sources.notes: Free plaza + Huddle at Gradient Canopy (2000 N Shoreline Blvd, MV). Sep 12 2026 Endless Summer Festival — magic shows, DJs, crafts, sports zone (all ages; toddler-friendly activations). Pop-up Parent & Me workshops (e.g. Mini Yoga Jul 2026 on Puddles). Check rsvp.withgoogle.com for upcoming Huddle events. Core-adjacent MV — not Sunnyvale.

sources.name: City of Sunnyvale · Special Events
sources.notes: Hands on the Arts Oct 17 2026 (41st annual) — on Puddles. Skip State of the City (Sep 19), Tech Business Expo (Oct 15). Farmers market alone is not an event. Winter holiday programming Nov–Dec TBD.

sources.name: Downtown Sunnyvale · Cityline & Murphy Ave
sources.notes: Mid-Autumn Festival Oct 3–4 (performances, family activities). Diwali Oct 3 SACAS — Kids Zone (diya painting, face paint, balloons). OMG Food Festival Sep 28–29 — food-forward; only include if clear kid activations posted. Saturday farmers market = vendors only (skip unless special kids booth).

sources.name: Sunnyvale Recreation · Parent & Tot
sources.notes: Super Safari Parent & Tot at Serra Park (ages 1.5–3.5; caregiver required). Fall 2026 sessions in Activities Guide — one semester row per session, not weekly spam. Registration: registration.sunnyvale.ca.gov (may require desk/phone during system transition).

sources.name: Sunnyvale Public Library · Kids Events
sources.notes: Baby Lapsit Thu 10:30, Night Owl Thu 7:00, Toddler Tue 11:00, Preschool Wed 11:00, Family Storytime Sat 11:00, Magical Bridge first Fridays. The kids calendar refuses the GitHub download. Wednesday browser pass opens this month and the next, re-bumps those series, and does not add a second row for the same storytime.

sources.name: Mountain View Special Events
sources.org: City of Mountain View · Community Services
sources.notes: Summer Music on Castro, Concerts on the Plaza, outdoor movies, festivals. Family-friendly all-ages; not toddler-specific. Site often blocks automated fetch (Akamai) — keep manual. Known child pages: harvest-history-festival (on Puddles as Harvest History Festival, Sep 26 2026, calendar Event/3482).

sources.name: Los Altos Family Fun Days
sources.org: City of Los Altos · Community Services
sources.notes: Free themed Saturdays 10am–1pm at Community Center with library partners. Aug 8 Pirate Palooza, Oct 24 Halloween Hoopla, Dec 12 Winter Wonderland — already Published.

sources.name: Downtown Los Altos Events
sources.notes: Most listings are adult. A BOO-tiful Downtown Halloween (Oct 30, ~12–4) is in Discovery.

sources.name: CSMA Concerts
sources.org: Community School of Music and Arts
sources.notes: Evening concert series (jazz/classical) — not ages 0–5. Prefer CSMA family days / Community Arts Day style programs when posted elsewhere on arts4all.org.

sources.name: Los Altos History Museum
sources.notes: Seasonal family programs (Train Day, holiday events). Skip adult-leaning lectures and galas. Train Day Aug 30 2026 — model trains, robotics demos, train films — on Puddles.

sources.name: Linden Tree Books
sources.notes: WEEKLY CHECK: scrape events-calendar for Sunday 10:30 Outdoor Storytime + named author picture-book storytimes (npm run discover:linden-tree). Skip YA/MG launches, book clubs, ages 7+ workshops.

sources.name: Home Depot Kids Workshop
sources.notes: Monthly free build workshops — Ages 2–5. Sep 5 + Oct 3 already Published.

sources.name: Oshman Family JCC · Jeff Center for Families
sources.notes: Free Family Play weekdays (Mon/Wed/Fri 9:30–5:30; Tue/Thu 1–5:30; check holiday/special hours). Doodle & Discover Wednesdays (free crafts ages 2–6). Skip Blossom paid prenatal/CPR for Browse.

sources.name: Peninsula Youth Theatre · Stories on Stage
sources.notes: Picture-book Stories on Stage at MVCPA SecondStage. Use pytnet.org/shows/ (not a single production URL). MVCPA listings that are PYT family shows belong here. Skip Center Stage musicals aimed at older kids (Wizard of Oz). Ordinary MVCPA adult theatre is out.

sources.name: Elizabeth F. Gamble Garden
sources.notes: Halloween Magic Oct 24 + Parent & Me Yoga Sep 19 (ages 4–8 + grown-up) in Discovery. Skip adult-leaning Halloween Tea.

sources.name: Marti Foster Yoga · Parent & Baby
sources.notes: Sat 11:15am–12:15pm Parent & Baby at Pioneer Memorial Park (weather permitting). Do not list Sat 10–11 prenatal as Parent & Me.

sources.name: Music Together Menlo Park & Palo Alto
sources.notes: Fall 2026 semester Sep 8–Nov 18. Represent as one series row (not weekly flood). Caregiver + child = Parent & Me / Music & Movement. Do not publish seat-level or waitlist-by-time in public tips — link to mt-mp.com for availability.

sources.name: Mini Yoga Club
sources.notes: Pop-up family yoga (e.g. Treehouse Silicon Valley Sep 26). Sunnyvale is a launch city as of Sep 2026.

sources.name: FIT4MOM Silicon Valley Central
sources.notes: Open the Glofox class list in a browser each Wednesday. Re-bump stroller classes and caregiver-and-baby classes. Skip virtual workouts, prenatal, run club, cancelled rows, and the pink community calendar. Week of Sep 29–Oct 6: Stroller Barre Cuesta Wed 10:00, Stroller Barre Mitchell Thu 10:00, Strides 360 Cuesta Fri 10:00, Stroller Strides Cuesta Mon 9:30, Mommy and Me Zumba and Mommy & Baby Yoga at Las Palmas Tue. Las Palmas Stroller Strides is not on that week. Fourth Trimester+ Wed Sep 30 is cancelled.

sources.name: Otto Family Club
sources.notes: Newsletter / Luma class list. One series row per standing class, not weekly spam. Check newsletters for Halloween and holiday pop-ups. No seat counts in public copy.

sources.name: Talo Yoga · CircleMoms host
sources.notes: Hosts CircleMoms newborn cohorts (not weekly drop-in Parent & Baby). Next PA cohort Oct 14. Adult/prenatal studio classes otherwise.

sources.name: Lemos Farm
sources.notes: Fall pumpkin patch Sep 5–Nov 15. Labor Day opening weekend. Paid timed admission — buy ahead on lemosfarm.com. Train, hay rides, petting zoo, ponies (weight limits apply). Worth a Drive · Hello Fall.

sources.name: East Bay Regional Parks · Garin Apple Festival
sources.notes: Annual one-day apple festival at Garin Regional Park. Free event; $5 cash parking. Orchard tours, cider pressing, crafts & games. Worth a Drive · Hello Fall.

sources.name: Roaring Camp Railroads
sources.notes: Labor Day steam or beach train + Town of Roaring Camp activities (gold panning, blacksmith, live music). Paid train tickets — check official site for times. Worth a Drive.

sources.name: Filoli · Seasonal Experiences
sources.notes: Worth a Drive only (Woodside). Autumn Days / Holidays / garden seasons can qualify when little ones have something to explore (trains, village, pumpkins). Skip Nightfall, wine, champagne, and adult previews. Hidden + isRegional — never Publish into Browse all-cities. Ordinary daytime admission is a place, not an event.

sources.name: Children’s Discovery Museum of San Jose
sources.org: Children’s Discovery Museum of San Jose
sources.notes: Regional inbox. Ordinary museum hours are a place, not an event. Dated specials (Daisy Day, holiday evenings) can queue. CDM Toddler Storytime (Wed–Sun 11:30, Wonder Cabinet) is designed for little ones and would be one Stories series row — hold until the city filter expands beyond the four core cities. Do not list it as Worth a Drive just to work around the city list. Skip Girl Scout badge days.

sources.name: The Tech Interactive
sources.notes: Regional inbox. Ordinary museum hours are a place, not an event. Dated family specials (Tech or Treat) can queue as Hidden Worth a Drive. Skip lasers/21+ and adult after-hours.

sources.name: Symphony San Jose · My Very First
sources.notes: Regional inbox. Concerts designed for young children. Capture series announcements; do not auto-publish early. Skip adult subscription concerts.

sources.name: SFJAZZ · Family Matinees
sources.notes: Regional inbox. Family matinees only. Skip evening adult concerts. Confirm age fit on the current official page before queuing.

sources.name: Deer Hollow Farm
sources.org: City of Mountain View · Deer Hollow Farm
sources.notes: Displays as Cupertino (22500 Cristo Rey Drive), not Mountain View. Regional / farm specials and dated storytimes belong; ordinary farm hours are a place, not an event. Hidden Villa stays Los Altos Hills — do not rename it Cupertino.

sources.name: Stanford Live
sources.notes: Watch as needed. Skip K–12 school matinees and the JS calendar when it is empty. Only dated public family performances with a clear 0–5 reason.
